data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a small prior-year release in 2014: the movement in the net provision for claims included a release of GBP 8.2m (2013: GBP 52.4m). However releases were materially smaller than in 2013 and were partially offset by adverse development (notably deterioration related to the New Zealand earthquakes of 2010/2011 totalling GBP 8.5m). Divisional commentary confirms reduced prior year reserve releases across Amlin London, Amlin UK and Amlin France. Overall the result reflects modest favourable prior-year development net of these deteriorations.

data.data_quality_notes: A GROSS prior-year movement (gross change in insurance liabilities) is not explicitly provided in the report. The report explicitly states a NET prior year release of GBP 8.2m; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is provided as the NET figure (release). This is a fallback because no gross PYD figure or gross claims development triangle was located. Divisional prior year release figures in the narrative are also net amounts. Where specific event impacts are quoted (e.g. New Zealand earthquake GBP 8.5m) those are used as quantified impacts.
